mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% is followed by positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises > 0.5% in 1 month is followed by positive 5-day forward returns in > 70% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 declines for 2 consecutive quarters is followed by positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% in one month signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO drops > 2% in 1 month is followed by positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 7%, it signals an accommodative monetary policy in a weak labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: accommodative policy in weak labor market
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS < 1% and UNRATE > 7% is followed by negative 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) for three consecutive months signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases for 3 consecutive months is followed by negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% in one month signals a strengthening housing market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases > 10% in 1 month is followed by negative 5-day forward returns in > 70% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (GDPC1) growth is above 2% YoY and consumer sentiment (proxied by RSAFS) is increasing, it signals a strong consumer demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 YoY > 2% and RSAFS increasing is followed by negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.
